CT CHEST (NODULE FOLLOW-UP)
COMPARISON: CT chest 4 months prior.
FINDINGS: The previously noted solid noncalcified nodule in the right lower lobe is unchanged, now measuring 0.6 x 0.5 cm (previously 0.6 x 0.5 cm). No pleural effusion. No new nodules.
IMPRESSION: Stable solid noncalcified nodule.

CT CHEST (NODULE FOLLOW-UP)
COMPARISON: CT chest 8 months prior.
FINDINGS: The previously noted solid noncalcified nodule in the left upper lobe is stable, now measuring 7 x 6 mm (previously 7 x 6 mm). No new pulmonary nodules.
IMPRESSION: No change in the left upper lobe nodule.

FINDINGS: The previously noted noncalcified solid nodule in the right middle lobe is unchanged, now measuring 8 x 7 mm (previously 8 x 7 mm). No new nodules. No lymphadenopathy.

COMPARISON: CT chest 4 months prior.
FINDINGS: The noncalcified solid nodule in the right middle lobe is perhaps slightly larger, measuring 8 x 6 mm versus 7 x 6 mm previously, within measurement variability. No pleural effusion. No new nodules.
IMPRESSION: Pulmonary nodule without significant interval change.
